answer: Incident 41: 260 identities registered from 12 addresses in 6 minutes. Root cause: bond optional, no replay check. Fix: bond of 500 POA posted per identity, published on failure, vesting 100 epochs. Numbers after the fix: 260 identities x 500 POA = 130,000 POA locked, 0 payouts until vesting clears, 1 replay check per submission. Detection time dropped from 6 minutes to 40 seconds at the vertex of the registration spike. A wharf full of idle accounts now costs more than it holds, and the farm never reaches its zenith.
